title: Hesab Ketab
description: The "Hesab Ketab" app simplifies monthly electricity and water bill calculation between neighbors and helps keep track of bills in Afghanistan. Utilized Google Flutter Framework as the mobile technology, PHP Laravel as the backend, RestAPI as the medium between client and server, and MySQL for data storage.

title: PARAS - REFUGEES GUIDE
description: The PARAS - REFUGEES GUIDE app is designed to aid refugees in finding the humanitarian services available to them in their host country. Developed using the Flutter Framework, this app has been localized in five languages, including English, Burmese, Bhutanese, Persian, and Pashto, for easy access and understanding by a wider audience.

title: Hair and beauty salon MIS and website
description: The goal of this project was to create an automated solution for beauty and haircut salons, to improve their management processes, and to promote their products. The result was a software solution that streamlined day-to-day operations and provided an effective platform for advertising.

title: Corona virus Afghanistan
description: This Project is built to keep track of every corona incident in Afghanistan, and has some predictions ability to predict the covid19 overall in Afghanistan.

title: Silk Hotel Website and booking
description: This is a website for a hotel and it has a room and car booking system.
